body: Corrected in commit `635afd0ae` at the existing AST-copy implementation. The clone now admits each retained shared projection node once, using the original census; scratch storage is released separately. Tests establish exact surviving grant/census equality, source-drop survival and deduplication through 128 nested scopes. The actual `prepare_execution`/`bind`/`execute` regression passes for explicit, star and nested-star queries. Affected Clippy and normal hooks pass.

Corrected in commit `ca31dbd7d`. The existing narrowing method accepts borrowed `ProjectionNames`, and both explicit and star callers use its original filtered-row builder. The temporary full-name collection is removed. Admitted empty-row substitution passes at widths 32, 256 and 2,048 under the same 4 KiB additional cap. Nonempty keep/exclude controls and complete grant release pass too; error handling remains at the existing home.

Corrected in commit `ca31dbd7d`: streamed projection now checks `ctx.growth.is_bounded()`, as materialized projection does. The regression uses a dataset with no storage-live budget and a bounded query workspace. The actual streamed callback receives all 256 columns while the live query reservation covers its schema; every grant is released afterward. Focused execution and warning-denied Clippy pass.

The bound-before-materialization alternative is already implemented here. The analysis passes the caller workspace to its schema builders, intersections, worklists and table insertion. The new regression in commit `e39c9a492` caches the 512-name child under its original source account, then exercises the parent star projection with a separate 4 KiB additional cap. The parent refuses through the original workspace error, keeps the child cache intact and releases all partial grants. The failed account stays stopped; a fresh caller operation succeeds after complete release. The final targeted test and strict Clippy pass. I am declining a schema-representation rewrite for this PR: the issue requires compact parsing/stored projections, whose operation/allocation controls pass. I am not claiming linear total node-analysis storage when a caller supplies an unrestricted budget.
